en: A colorized historical postcard view of a riverside town with a stone bridge crossing a broad river, a curving railway line in the foreground, factory buildings with chimneys, and a large hilltop castle complex overlooking the town. The scene is labeled in German at the top with the town name and the castle and bridge. The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
